tree: Hartley Electric in Reno, NV is a two-person electrical contractor. Owner Dean Hartley invoices for larger jobs and takes card payments on site.

tree: — Dean sends Marisol Cortez invoice INV-2207 for $2,165.00 after a panel upgrade.
— She pays $1,000.00 by card; the receipt shows a $1,165.00 Balance Due.
— Her accountant asks for the invoice; Dean finds and resends it in seconds.
— A $45.00 refund for an unused part is linked to the original receipt.
